findings.summary: renameSkill imported but unused — no UI surface for rename
findings.detail: The renameSkill function is imported from api/client but no handler or button invokes it. Dead import.
findings.recommendation: Remove unused import, or add rename capability if needed later

findings.summary: JSON.stringify filter for search is inefficient
findings.detail: filteredItems uses JSON.stringify(item).toLowerCase().includes() for search. Acceptable for the small skill count expected (<50), but not scalable.

findings.summary: createEntity does not await _embedEntity — fire-and-forget by design
findings.detail: Entity creation returns ID synchronously while embedding happens in background. The try/catch in _embedEntity ensures failures don't propagate. Acceptable pattern for best-effort embedding.
findings.recommendation: Accept as-is — consistent with graceful degradation design

summary: Clean implementation across all 5 modified files. No blockers, no critical issues. Type safety improved with StreamErrorPayload interface. Embedding pipeline follows graceful degradation pattern. Drag-drop and Skill CRUD are well-contained additions with proper test coverage. Minor dead import (renameSkill) to clean up.
